title: Machop Is Child-Sized With Ridiculous Strength

direction.premise: Machop is only 0.8 meters tall, yet official Pokédex entries say it can hurl one hundred adults.
direction.audiencePromise: Compare Machop's child-sized frame with its astonishing official strength claim, then test how consistent that claim is.
direction.openLoop: How can something this small supposedly throw one hundred grown-ups?
direction.payoff: Machop's child-sized design hides a strength fantasy, while another Pokédex entry makes that claim feel surprisingly grounded.
direction.engagementQuestion: Is Machop's hundred-adult claim iconic, or does one adult feel more believable?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan telling a friend something wild. Keep the pace quick, warm, and playful. Stress the size contrast and pause before the strength claim.

scenes.headline: CHILD-SIZED. ONE HUNDRED ADULTS.
scenes.narration: Child-sized Machop can throw one hundred adults.
scenes.caption: TINY FIGHTER. HUGE CLAIM.

scenes.headline: THE HEIGHT DOESN'T MATCH
scenes.narration: Machop stands just 0.8 meters tall, about human-child height.
scenes.caption: 0.8 METERS TALL

scenes.headline: MUSCLES THAT NEVER QUIT
scenes.narration: Its whole body is muscle, and its muscles never get sore.
scenes.caption: TRAINING DOESN'T WEAR IT DOWN

scenes.headline: IT TRAINS WITH GRAVELER
scenes.narration: That power is built by lifting Graveler every day.
scenes.caption: DAILY GRAVELER TRAINING

scenes.headline: THE POKÉDEX SWERVES
scenes.narration: Then the Pokédex swerves: one entry says one well-built adult.
scenes.caption: ONE WELL-BUILT ADULT

scenes.headline: A PERFECT SIZE TRAP
scenes.narration: Machop is a perfect size trap: strength fantasy or overstatement?
scenes.caption: STRENGTH FANTASY OR OVERSTATEMENT?
